caption: The drawing depicts a single decorative wooden object centered on a plain, light beige background. The object is a rectangular panel with a scalloped top edge and notched lower corners, painted in warm, muted tones of pinkish-brown and beige, with subtle blue-gray and yellow highlights. The panel features detailed ornamental designs, including stylized leaves on either side, a pair of circular shapes in the center—one brown and the other blue—and additional swirling foliate patterns outlined in a reddish-brown color. Thin yellow lines accentuate parts of the lower edge of the panel, and the decorative motifs suggest influences of floral and botanical patterns. The artwork is signed and dated on the lower right side of the panel in small text. The rest of the composition remains unadorned.
title: Chair Back Decoration
